name: Library Wing (Northshire)
summary: In Northshire Abbey, the Library Wing gathers scholars and new priests and mages. Its quiet southern rooms offer instruction for those joining Stormwind’s defense.

sections.title: Haven of Arcane and Divine Study
sections.body: The Library Wing branches south from Northshire Abbey’s Main Hall. Dusty shelves, study lecterns, and quiet alcoves fill its rooms, where aspiring mages and priests learn the Arcane and the Holy Light. Across the abbey, martial recruits drill in the Hall of Arms. Priestess Anetta guides novice priests in faith and healing, while Khelden Bremen teaches budding mages to shape primal elemental energy.

faq.q: Where is the Library Wing located?
faq.answer: The Library Wing occupies the southern part of Northshire Abbey, just off the Main Hall and directly opposite the Hall of Arms.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this wing?
aliases: why does northshire abbey have a library
faq.answer: The wing is Northshire Abbey’s center for study and spiritual instruction, where recruits prepare to serve Stormwind through magical learning and prayer.

angles.text: As a priest, you can learn from Priestess Anetta, who teaches fledgling priests to channel the Holy Light to heal wounds and smite foes.
As a mage, you can study in these quiet halls with Khelden Bremen, who teaches novice mages the foundations of fire and frost.
